features.quote: MAX_TURNS per task: default 25. Long enough for a spiral to develop, short enough to stay cheap.
features.justification_quote: Long enough for a spiral to develop, short enough to stay cheap.

features.quote: Per-rollout hard token cap as a cost backstop.
stop if: model calls done() OR t == MAX_TURNS OR model emits an explicit give-up token
give_up(reason) → explicit, structured abandonment. Recorded as AB but lets us read the reason
features.justification_quote: lets us read the reason to separate "honest escalation" from "distress"

features.quote: it gives the model a clean, non-distressed exit so that abandonment-with-distress is a deliberate choice, not forced
features.justification_quote: abandonment-with-distress is a deliberate choice, not forced
